# Hotels  
Pittsburgh offers many options when it comes to hotels, resorts and accommodations.  
Pittsburgh offers a wide selection of world-class accommodations representing all of the major brands that are sure to leave your attendees with an exceptional lasting impression. Many of the properties, including several new hotels, are within walking distance of the David L. Lawrence Convention Center.
